name: postmortem-improve
description: Run a postmortem → improve loop so LibrAgent sessions learn without dirtying project git. Capture evidence-backed failures, then apply a Top-1 update to `@harness/LESSONS.active.md` (app-local; injected into the system prompt) for behavioral defects, or route deterministic tool/code defects to a fix/bug task (never paper over with lessons). Works for solo sessions and org/teamwork. Use after incidents, repeated failures, mission retros, stuck KANBAN/Blocked items, or when the user asks for continuous improvement / after-action review. Not for one-off task execution, initial team bootstrap (use teamwork), or first-time org create (use org).
